applicabilityBasis.summary: Electronic Dollar is a Reserve RToken minted and redeemed against an on-chain collateral basket. No legal issuer obligation to convert it into a fixed amount of national currency or a bank deposit was identified; payment-stablecoin applicability remains ambiguous rather than established by its USD peg.

genius.issuerEntity: Electronic Dollar governance / Reserve Protocol RToken governors
genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. Permissionless RToken issuance/redemption returns collateral tokens and differs from a demonstrated contractual USD redemption obligation. Reserve governance can change baskets and throttle operations; decentralized branding alone does not establish an exclusion. The existing issuerEntity is retained as a governance descriptor, not a verified incorporated legal issuer or approved PPSI. Reserve disclosure refers to its on-chain dashboard, not fiat reserves or an accountant attestation. The previously recorded dashboard-disclosure flag is retained, but current dashboard contents could not be independently rendered: static HTML was an application shell and two owned browser attempts failed before navigation. Current disclosure availability requires further verification; no reserve amounts are asserted. No exact-token GENIUS authorization, official application, registered foreign exception, or GENIUS enforcement action was located in the bounded review. Proposed substantive rules and the state-certification procedural interim rule are not issuer approvals.
